The data only contains 64 streams: 18 zone air temperature sensors, cooling/heating setpoints, and damper position setpoints. There is no supply air flow, no supply air temperature, no VAV damper position/valve command, no zone or room electric power, no occupancy, no CO2, and—critically—the zone's own thermostat (VAV_F3_Z01.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor), which would let us cross-check the monitoring sensor, is not in the data.

Without any stream that reflects actual load (power, flow, occupancy) or an independent temperature measurement, I cannot tell whether the rise in F3Z01's reported temperature is a real local-load effect or just a monitoring-sensor bias. Multiple zones also rose modestly (so the shift isn't uniquely the sensor), but there's no load-side evidence in either direction.
